retained_foundations: GRT86 identifies the actual smooth group and integral frames on the marked interior negative member at every residue prime. For each use of the cutoff estimates one must verify the signature and level of the member and identify its same reference model, metrics and lattices at both cutoffs.

GRT87 and GRT91 construct the formal theta tuple and the generic object at a common auxiliary prime tower. To obtain the entire prescribed arc over each admissible power-series coefficient base, compare that object with the specified split uniformization at every required independent division level and compatible embedding, descend the marked generic point, and identify its specialization at the specified uniformizer. GRT88–90 supply the row, column, determinant and integral-map arguments once those identifications are available.

The applicable arithmetic intersection and resolution system, its projection formula and changes of metric remain inputs. GRT34 computes the two Newton identities, GRT52 the uniform determinant, and GRT57 the fixed-tower wall height on this system.
